Package sootup.callgraph

Class SignaturePolymorphicMethods

java.lang.Object
sootup.callgraph.SignaturePolymorphicMethods
public final class SignaturePolymorphicMethods extends Object
Resolution of signature-polymorphic methods (JVMS 2.9.3, 5.4.3.3), e.g. MethodHandle.invokeExact, VarHandle.get, MethodHandle.linkToStatic.

Call site keeps its own descriptor, e.g. invokeExact(String,String,int)int; declared method is native varargs invokeExact(Object[])Object. Plain sub-signature lookup misses. Rule: declared in java.lang.invoke.MethodHandle or VarHandle, single Object[] param, ACC_VARARGS | ACC_NATIVE, and only method of that name in the class. Flags, not the package-private @PolymorphicSignature annotation.

Cost: callers ask only after a regular lookup missed. Non-holder classes rejected by two string compares on already-stored names (no FQN allocation).
